prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are helpful, producing 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, yielding 2 significant wins (+11.5%, +7.2%), while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-10.9%) and 1 test with no clear effect.
sign_in, hint and adoption, copy changes showed no clear effect across tested iterations.
sign_in, reorder changes remain inconsistent across 2 tests, producing 1 significant win (+12.3%) and 1 significant loss (-7.1%).
Predictions remain inaccurate overall by overestimating weak ideas and underestimating big wins, and evidence remains thin for kinds of change with only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +3.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -5.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +4.0% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 94.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 85.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Progress Milestone Tracker: Displays animated backend generation milestone stages directly on the waiting screen to give users transparency into pet asset rendering and personality synthesis. (why: The home step has a high mean duration of 2336s. Historical data shows home wait_info changes generated 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%).)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Placement Guided Calibration Flow: Adds an interactive post-onboarding calibration step where users click and drag their newly adopted companion to set its home dock boundary on their desktop. (why: Support emails report pet not showing on desktop or users being confused about pet controls. Finish new_flow changes have yielded strong historical gains (+11.5%, +7.2%).)
2: [finish, new_screen] Companion Command Shortcut Masterclass Screen: Introduces a new shortcut reference screen before finishing onboarding detailing hotkeys and system tray toggles for hiding and interacting with the pet. (why: Support logged 3 emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step changes show strong potential for conversion.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Audio and Interaction Sensitivity Setup Flow: Adds a short audio volume and window collision sensitivity configuration screen to the end of onboarding. (why: Support received emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior post-setup. Finish new_flow changes previously yielded +11.5% and +7.2% wins.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Custom Ribbon Selection: Offers users an interactive ribbon badge selector to stamp onto their digital adoption certificate before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest dropoff point in the funnel (66.8% conversion). Adding engaging customization incentives improves adoption stage completion.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Background Generation Audio Notification Switch: Adds an explicit toggle and audio option on the waiting screen so users are notified with a gentle chime when pet creation finishes in the background. (why: Home wait times have a mean of 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting. Audio notifications prevent abandonment while waiting.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Workspace Desktop Fit Guidance Hint: Displays a clear compatibility notice on the story screen reassuring users that pets seamlessly function across single and multi-monitor setups. (why: Users take a mean of 514s on path choice. Reassuring users early about desktop display compatibility reduces hesitation before committing to a path.)
